name: challengex
description: ChallengeX — gamified idea-validation and innovation platform. Root orchestration only; all application code lives in frontend/, admin/ and backend/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix admin && npm run test --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix backend
